_comment: One shelf zone. Origin = front-left corner of the shelf floor. x = along length (left->right), y = depth (front/aisle -> back wall), z = up from shelf floor. Inches. Quadrants split at x = length/2 and y = depth/2: FL, FR (front), BL, BR (back).

reference_tag._comment: Fixed tag that never moves (e.g. center of back wall, mid height). Must be read by all 4 antennas. Used to remove each port's cable/reader phase slope in EVERY capture (also tracks drift). Set its EPC.
